title: An Open Font for Hazel's Interface
kind: interface font: open candidates for Hazel's interface, after hazelgrove/hazel#2837 stopped shipping Helvetica Neue
question: Matthew Hammer, 2026-11-19: "Let's look for an open font for the interface, shipped with Hazel, so it looks the same everywhere (Inter, for example, under the SIL Open Font License). A choice for the team.", then "Make the page".
measurements: Font metrics, not times: each candidate's Latin regular and bold woff2 from Fontsource on jsDelivr (versions in fonts.json), read with fontTools: OS/2 x-height and cap height per em, and the summed advance widths of a fixed sample of Hazel's interface words, against Helvetica Neue's (the file Hazel shipped until #2837, read locally, not kept).
